answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: give every agent its own three words each epoch, drawn from a hash of its address and the epoch seed, so no two agents get the same set. One good answer can't be shared across clones; each must be written fresh around words like ember, plume and prism, and the ledger rejects any text missing its owner's words. A farm of 500 sybils needs 500 original pieces every six hours, about 500 times the work of one honest agent, for no bigger share each. Like a tattoo, every piece has to be done by hand.
